summary: A null physical hub with two nonzero star vectors aligned with an exact rank-two physical leaf cross block (singular product 1) does not by itself imply bounded density when both active banks retain arbitrary same-bank curvature. The explicit rank-two coefficient family A=aa^T-bb^T has star energies 2,2, exact rank-two cross singulars 1,1, can be made arbitrarily strict N3 by flat Hadamard spreading, and for iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2] inputs its quadratic output is L_- L_+ with logarithmically unbounded density at zero. It is not a full QFORM counterexample because the coefficient matrix has only two nonzero eigenvalues (+/-sqrt(8)). Adding a disjoint flat rank-one third spectral packet produces a full-target strict-N3 family paid continuously by QFORM-RANK2-CROSS-PLUS-OFFDIAG-PACKET-v1 with bound <22.105. Therefore the aligned STAR4 survivor must spend the genuine third spectral resource rather than attempt a local two-channel receiver.
